stations.title: Kasimir
stations.say: Long jobs first, in the morning.

stations.title: The bench list
stations.text: Repairs in the order tickets came in.

stations.title: The bench
stations.text: Work starts with the longest job.

captions: Kasimir wants the long jobs started first thing in the morning.
The bench list is in ticket order, so a long job can wait until the afternoon.
You hand the library's tools rules of your own: order, find, count, price and clear.
The bench list comes back in Kasimir's order, longest first.
The list answers whatever Kasimir asks of it. Next, rules kept and looked up by name.
